label: copy phase: just emitted z (late), about to output 1/z/m
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (96% of mass) on steps whose input is z, i.e. right after the model has emitted z, and only late in the copy (recall_idx >= 3, mostly 4-8; nothing earlier). Strongest when the token being output next is 1 (64% of mass, 30x lift), then z or m; magnitude is larger when the z comes late in a long sequence (L = 8-9). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases or on any other input except rare 1/m inputs. The input-z-late condition alone has high recall but low precision (most such steps are silent); adding out_tok in {1, z, m} gives F1 about 0.56 on dev.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=z (+7.04), phase=2 & out_tok=1 (+4.06), out_tok=1 (+3.73), phase=2 & in_tok=1 (+3.48), in_tok=z (+3.47), phase=2 & in_tok=m (+3.22). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-3.27), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.27), prev2_tok=<DEL> (-2.91), recall_idx=2 (-2.91).
